ViridianCity_Text_CanCarryMonsAnywhere:
Those POKé BALLS at your waist! You have POKéMON, don't you?
It's great that you can carry and use POKéMON anytime, anywhere.
ViridianCity_Text_GymClosedWonderWhoLead:
This POKéMON GYM is always closed.
I wonder who the LEADER is?
ViridianCity_Text_WantToKnowAboutCaterpi: You want to know about the two kinds of caterpillar POKéMON?
ViridianCity_Text_ExplainCaterpieWeedle:
CATERPIE has no poison, but WEEDLE does.
Watch that your POKéMON aren't stabbed by WEEDLE's POISON STING.
ViridianCity_Text_GrandpaHasntHadCoffeeY:
Oh, Grandpa! Don't be so mean!
I'm so sorry. He hasn't had his coffee yet.
ViridianCity_Text_GoShoppingInPewterOcca:
I go shopping in PEWTER CITY occasionally.
I have to take the winding trail in VIRIDIAN FOREST when I go.
ViridianCity_Text_ThisIsPrivateProperty:
I absolutely forbid you from going through here!
This is private property!
ViridianCity_Text_ShowYouHowToCatchMons:
Well, now, I've had my coffee, and that's what I need to get going!
Hm? What is that red box you have?
Ah, so you're working on your POKéDEX.
Then let me give you a word of advice.
Whenever you catch a POKéMON, the POKéDEX automatically updates its data.
…You don't know how to catch a POKéMON?
I suppose I had better show you then!
ViridianCity_Text_ThatWasEducationalTake:
There! Now tell me, that was educational, was it not?
And here, take this, too.
ViridianCity_Text_WatchThatToLearnBasics:
If there's something you don't understand, watch that.
It will teach you about the basics of being a POKéMON TRAINER.
ViridianCity_Text_WeakenMonsFirstToCatch:
Well, now, I've had my coffee, and that's what I need to get going!
But I made it too strong. It gave me a headache…
Incidentally, are you filling your POKéDEX?
At first, focus on weakening the POKéMON before trying to catch it.
ViridianCity_Text_HowsTeachyTVHelping:
Well, now, I've had my coffee, and that's what I need to get going!
But I made it too strong. It gave me a headache…
Incidentally, is my old TEACHY TV helping you?
ViridianCity_Text_MyGrandsonOnTheShow:
Wahaha! It's my grandson on the show!
Since he's the one doing the teaching, you're bound to learn.
ViridianCity_Text_TooBusyForTeachyTV:
Hm… You're too busy to not even have the time for TEACHY TV…
Time is money, and neither should be ill spent…
ViridianCity_Text_CitySign: VIRIDIAN CITY  The Eternally Green Paradise
ViridianCity_Text_CatchMonsForEasierBatt:
TRAINER TIPS
Catch POKéMON and expand your collection.
The more you have, the easier it is to battle.
ViridianCity_Text_MovesLimitedByPP:
TRAINER TIPS
The battle moves of POKéMON are limited by their POWER POINTS, PP.
To replenish PP, rest your tired POKéMON at a POKéMON CENTER.
